name: Spotify - Privacy Policy (Sensor & Advertising Tracking)
text: 3. Information We Collect and Third-Party Disclosures. When you use the Spotify Service, we may collect technical data including your IP address, device motion characteristics, and approximate or exact coordinates. Specifically, we may share your precise location, sensor data, and listening history with advertising partners to personalize sponsored recommendations and audience measurement.

name: Adobe - General Terms of Use (Automated Content Analysis)
text: 4.1 Content Analysis. We may access, view, or listen to your content through both automated and manual methods, for example, to analyze your content using machine learning to improve our services and features. If you store files in Creative Cloud, our systems automatically index and process metadata and visual assets.

name: Zoom - Terms of Service (AI Model Training Clause)
text: 10.2 Service Generated Data and Customer Content. Zoom does not use your audio, video, or chat Customer Content to train our artificial intelligence models without your consent, EXCEPT that you agree that Zoom may process customer content for the purpose of training machine learning or artificial intelligence models to improve service quality, provide automated summaries, and system telemetry.
